summary: New page: pick baseball or softball, find your child's birth date, see the league age and division. Why: this used to send parents off to littleleague.org and they got lost.
blurb: A new page that turns a birth date into a league age and a BLS division, without leaving the site.

sources.fact: "The Age Determination Date for a Little League Baseball player is the actual age of a child on August 31 of the current year." For 2027 that is Aug 31, 2027.

"The Age Determination Date for a Little League Softball player is the actual age of a child on December 31 of the previous year." For 2027 that is Dec 31, 2026. The page covers league ages 4 through 16.
Baseball divisions by league age (Tee Ball 4-6, Coach Pitch 6-7, AA 8-9, Minors 9-11, Majors 11-12, 50/70 12-13, Juniors 13-14): the live FAQ #7 and the Registration page chart.
Softball divisions by league age (Co-Ed T-Ball 4-6, Minors B 6-8, Minors A 8-11, Majors 11-12, Juniors 13-14): the Registration page chart, matching the posted Fall Ball age guidelines.
Challenger Division is adaptive baseball for players with physical and intellectual challenges, ages 4 to 18 (up to 22 if still in school); questions to vpchallenger@blslittleleague.org.
BLS serves the Bonney Lake, Sumner and Orting communities (Instagram profile bio).

long_summary: New page: a Baseball/Softball switch, then a birth-date table for league ages 4 to 16 (baseball = age on Aug 31, 2027; softball = age on Dec 31, 2026) with the BLS division beside each age, the division chips from the Registration page, the Challenger contact, the towns BLS serves with the President's email for boundary questions, and a Registration button. No outside links. Replaces every League Age Calculator link that sent parents off the site.
